name: color-visual-transfer-protocol
description: Color Visual Transfer Protocol: offline file and text transfer over QR and COLOR_4 optical signals.

scripts.build:standalone: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-standalone',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run typecheck && vite build --mode standalone-send && vite build --mode standalone-receive
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:standalone
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && npm run test:perf
scripts.test:color4: npm run typecheck && node --import tsx --test tests/color4-*.test.ts tests/experiments.test.ts tests/frame-timing.test.ts tests/platform.test.ts tests/receiver-defaults.test.ts && npm run test:perf
